_comment: Which web bundle each audience of the native app gets. See docs/ota-updates.md.
version: what THIS build publishes. Bump it whenever the game changes, and only then. Must stay above the app shell's versionName.
public: the version everyone gets. Point it at any hosted version to release or roll back. null until the first release.
beta: null unless something is being tested; opted-in players get public while it is null. Promote with public: <same number>, beta: null.
minNative: the lowest app shell versionName this bundle runs on. Raise it in the commit that makes game code need new native code.
keep: how many versions stay hosted. The build fails if public or beta names one that is not.
delta: false serves the plain zip instead of the per-file manifest. The rollback if updates stop applying.
